sentence: he lied to my face again and acted like it was nothing
i swear if one more person touches my stuff i will lose it
my heart wont stop racing and i keep checking my phone for the results
what if i fail and everyone finds out
the teacher explained it three times and i still have no clue what is going on
i dont know if im supposed to be happy or upset about this
i trained for months and still didnt make the team
i expected so much more from this trip honestly
the milk had gone bad and the smell made me want to throw up
i cant believe he treated the waiter like that it was gross
i called my teacher mom in front of everyone
my voice cracked during the presentation and the whole room heard
tickets just dropped and im literally shaking cant wait
we leave for goa tomorrow morning and i havent stopped grinning
i heard footsteps behind me on the empty road and froze
the plane started shaking and i gripped the seat tight
the wifi keeps dropping right when i submit the assignment
ive tried fixing this bug all night and nothing works
my neighbour stayed up with me at the hospital i dont know how to thank her
thank you for believing in me when i didnt
i forgot my sisters birthday and she didnt say a word
i took credit for his work and now i cant look at him
sunday morning chai and rain outside feels perfect
my dog greeted me at the door and my whole day got better
the interview went okay so maybe things are finally turning around
i think next year will be better for us
she posts her holiday pics and i just feel sick scrolling
why does he get everything without even trying
sat alone in the canteen again today
the group chat is active but nobody ever messages me directly
i smile every time i see her name pop up on my phone
he remembered how i like my tea and i melted
my little brother cleared the exam and i teared up for him
i built the whole app myself and it actually works
the test results came back fine and i finally breathed out
the train was delayed but i made it just in time
i keep looking at old photos of grandma and crying
nothing feels fun anymore since he left
walked into my room and the whole family was there shouting
i opened the box and it was the exact phone i never told anyone about
